candidateOccurrences.sourceText: Moses gave to them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan; the land, according to its cities and borders, even the cities of the surrounding land.
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us beyond the Jordan.”
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: The children of Gad built Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
candidateOccurrences.relationshipNoteJa: 本文は「ガドの子ら」という部族集団を名指す。地域名の直接表記ではなく、ガド族への割当文脈に基づく地域カードの候補用例。

candidateOccurrences.sourceText: for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their fathers’ houses, the tribe of the children of Gad according to their fathers’ houses, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance.
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, “This is the land which you shall inherit by lot, which the LORD has commanded to give to the nine tribes, and to the half-tribe;
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: The two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward the sunrise.”
candidateOccurrences.relationshipNoteJa: ガド族を相続地を受けた部族として列挙。地域名の直接表記とは区別。
